Operator Action Required: - Add Sentry (frontend + server-side) for error tracking. - Set up UptimeRobot or Better Stack to poll /api/health every 30 seconds from 3+ regions. - Publish a status page (statuspage.io, instatus.com, or self-hosted). - Add OpenTelemetry instrumentation for distributed tracing. - Configure Vercel Log Drain to a log aggregator (Logtail, Datadog, Loki, etc.). - Set up alerts for: * 5xx error rate > 1% over 5 minutes * p95 response time > 500ms over 5 minutes * /api/health returns non-200 for 3 consecutive checks * Supabase connection errors > 0 in 1 minute
